response.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) AS avg_season_to_date_wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1 AND wins IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: "Upwards of 1 point" means strictly more than 1 (points > 1). Points equal to exactly 1 are excluded.

Because driverStandings.points and driverStandings.wins are season-to-date running values (verified on the data), each row's points and wins already describe the season so far, so no extra per-season aggregation is needed.
Rows with NULL points or NULL wins are ignored, and AVG returns the unrounded mean.

alternatives.interpretation: "Upwards of 1 point" includes exactly 1 point (points >= 1, i.e. at least 1 point).
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) AS avg_season_to_date_wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points >= 1 AND wins IS NOT NULL;

alternatives.interpretation: "Upwards of 1 point" includes exactly 1 point (points >= 1, i.e. at least 1 point).
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) AS avg_season_to_date_wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points >= 1 AND wins IS NOT NULL;
